method: simple MER x balance x years (NOT compounded; compounding would make high-fee products look worse)
assumptions_status: ASSUMED illustrative MERs, not scraped from fund documents. Ratios are robust; absolute dollars are not.

direct_index.label: Direct index ownership (no wrapper)
direct_index.note: No ongoing management fee. Transaction/spread costs are separate and are NOT counted here.

index_etf.label: Broad-market index ETF
index_etf.note: ASSUMED ~0.105%/yr blend of a US total-market ETF and a CAD-listed equivalent.

index_mutual_fund.label: Low-MER index mutual fund
index_mutual_fund.note: ASSUMED ~0.45%/yr. Typically 3-5x the ETF version for the same underlying exposure.

active_mutual_fund.label: Active mutual fund
active_mutual_fund.note: ASSUMED ~1.85%/yr, typical of Canadian active equity funds incl. trailing commission.

fixed_fee_note: A FIXED fee is an account-size decision, not a fund-quality decision. A $25/yr admin fee is 4.5%/yr on a $550 account and 0.05% on $50,000. Any MER comparison that omits the fixed component is wrong for small accounts.

measured_separately.note: One FX-avoidance decision is worth 150x every MER difference here.
